'''A Nerf Herder's Guide to Nerfs''' was a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]-[[Book/Legends|book]] about [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] written during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The book contained various research concerning nerfs, covering their diet and recent history. Among other things, the guide described a mysterious rare [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] plant favored by nerfs, and covered an unsuccessful attempt of raising nerfs on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It also mentioned nerfs' appearance within the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]], however did not go into details explaining what drew them into the area.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=other|Datapads: "Researching Nerfs", found on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and [[Voss]], used in a hidden achievement quest}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The guide appears in [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of a hidden achievement quest. Mentioned in the guide little nerfs raised on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] can be found on the icy planet, still little and alive despite being lost, meaning that the guide was written soon after the failed attempt of nerfs' acclimatization to Hoth at some point during the [[Cold War]].
